comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber; pr-360 matches caps to four pens and sorts the completed pens by color.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, tightening, and dynamic test cycling. pr-360 requires repeated cap-to-barrel alignment/insertion and released placement into marked regions.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe carriage stops and post-lock setting retention. pr-360 requires all four matching caps retained for 1 s and all pens released, still, horizontal, and fully inside their correct areas.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests adjustment and validation of a mechanical energy absorber, not repeated closure insertion and sorting. The record’s fixed-joint cap approximation does not create a shared locking objective. Candidate drift, rebound, and overload limits are incompletely specified.
